response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT s.instownpct AS own, t.ordertypedist AS ot FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT AVG(own) AS a FROM j), o AS (SELECT ot, AVG(own) AS oa FROM j GROUP BY ot) SELECT AVG(j.own) AS avg_ownership, AVG(j.own * 1.0 / o.oa) AS avg_ratio_to_type_avg, AVG(j.own - g.a) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM j JOIN o ON j.ot = o.ot CROSS JOIN g WHERE j.own > g.a
